{{Top|leg}}
The '''Thyrsian military''' was the military of the [[Thyrsian]]s, members of the [[Echani/Legends|Echani]] [[Species/Legends|species]] [[Homeworld/Legends|native]] to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Thyrsus/Legends|Thyrsus]]. Its units bore the the emblem of the [[Color/Legends|red]] [[Star/Legends|suns]] of [[Thyrsus/Legends|Thyrsus]]. The [[Sun Guard]] began as a special-missions force in the Thyrsian military hierarchy known as the [[Thyrsian special forces]].<ref name="Galaxy at War">''[[Galaxy at War]]''</ref>
